skill_name: How does large data collection benefit society?
workflow: Large data collection can help society understand, quantify, and predict various social, economic, and political outcomes. Manipulation of large datasets can lead to new insights, often very quickly. For example, in healthcare, data analysis of large amounts of data can support the early detection of diseases and provide a more personalized approach to treatment.
